d.title: Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann: Mitee Mono wa Miteen da!!
d.en: Gurren Lagann: There are Some Things I Just Have to See!!
d.jp: 天元突破 グレンラガン  見てえものは見てえんだ!!
d.synopsis: An uncut version of episode six, involving Kamina's hopes of seeing Yoko and The Black Siblings naked, even at the risk of his friends' safety.
